_review: Known limitations, from the adversarial review. (1) These are CATEGORY codes carrying SKU phrasings: entries naming a plainly different product were deleted, but pack, carton and dozen wordings remain filed against single-unit codes, and a matcher scoring well on those would be conflating price points a price monitor exists to keep apart. (2) Recall-only: every line is a labelled positive, there are no distractors belonging to no catalogue item, so precision cannot be measured here. (3) The distribution is flat at roughly 30 per product; real reporter traffic is Zipfian. (4) A dozen entries are single bare nouns that are genuinely unanswerable from the string alone. (5) No Arabizi / franco-arabe, which is how a large share of people actually type. (6) Some brands could not be verified against a real shelf.
